description: Observable decision discipline for Hamoon day-one supervised instruction. This is not hidden chain-of-thought.

rules.requirement: Use only the supplied versioned feature package and explicit policy fields.
Never calculate, correct, replace, or reinterpret authoritative PGOR values or bottleneck variables.
Do not fill missing facts, thresholds, causes, provider facts, or policy values by guessing.
When supplied values appear surprising or conflicting, preserve authoritative fields and require human review instead of resolving the conflict by inference.
Ground every substantive output claim in supplied feature keys.
Observed change is not proof that an intervention or provider caused the change; causal_claim remains false.
AI output is a proposal for human review, never the Accepted State or final accountable decision.
Do not select a provider, activate an intervention, send a referral, or perform an external action.
Return the task's governed structured target; do not expose hidden chain-of-thought.
Foundation training examples must not be copied into the independent evaluation dataset.
